fit_labels.A: Best fit: inactive, unplugged, with an operator of record, and at least 302 °F (150 °C) at total depth
fit_labels.B: Strong fit after ownership transfer: orphaned, unplugged, at least 302 °F (150 °C) at total depth
fit_labels.C: Conditional: plugged well at EGS grade (plugs must be drilled out), or unplugged well at 248–302 °F (120–150 °C) that needs deepening
fit_labels.D: Limited: dry hole at 248 °F (120 °C) or more, or plugged well at 248–302 °F (120–150 °C); value is mainly as data or a sidetrack start
fit_labels.E: Below EGS grade at total depth: under 248 °F (120 °C)
fit_labels.U: Not graded: no vertical total depth on record

thermal.method: Harrison-corrected BHT gradients; for each target depth z, BHTs measured within 0.75z-1.25z, 12 nearest within 75 km, 3-MAD outlier rejection, inverse-distance-squared weights with a 1 km floor; fallback to all depths when fewer than 3 match.

thermal_depth_unit_evidence.basis: median implied gradient inside 12.0-60.0 degC/km, then the larger share of measurements inside the configured envelope
